description: This file defines the SettingsTab SwiftUI View for an iOS app, which manages various application settings, gateway connections, device features, and onboarding controls. It includes UI components for gateway discovery, feature toggles, device info, and setup code handling.

methods.name: applySetupCodeAndConnect
methods.description: Applies the setup code, validates input, and initiates connection to the gateway based on the setup code.

methods.name: applySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes and processes the raw setup code input, extracting configuration details and saving credentials.

methods.name: applySetupURL
methods.description: Parses a URL from the setup code and updates manual gateway connection parameters accordingly.

methods.name: resolvedManualPort
methods.description: Determines the correct port for manual gateway connection based on inputs and TLS policies.

methods.name: preflightGateway
methods.description: Performs a TCP reachability check to ensure the gateway host is accessible.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Attempts to connect manually to a gateway using specified host, port, and TLS settings.

methods.name: gatewayDebugText
methods.description: Generates a debug string containing the current gateway, discovery, and status information.

methods.name: lastKnownButtonLabel
methods.description: Returns a view label for the last-known gateway connection button, displaying connection status.

methods.name: syncManualPortText
methods.description: Synchronizes the manual port text field with the current port value.

methods.name: resetOnboarding
methods.description: Resets onboarding state, clears stored credentials, disconnects gateways, and clears related app state.

methods.name: gatewayDetailLines
methods.description: Generates detail lines for a discovered gateway, including LAN, tailnet, and port info.
